content: Hey other Alex, could you please take some time and review https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen/pull/1762, its pretty important because it currently completely prevents us (PumpkinMC) to have C++ bindings
ideally we would also get https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen/pull/1763 merged because we rely on much async stuff but the first Pull request is more important atm
Alex is OOO friday and today, and we don't know when he will be back - he's doing little bits here and there when he can get to his comptuer but is at limited capacity, please be paitient

I am not really a C++ expert myself so I can't personally review PRs like that. I've been hoping others would come out of the woodwork to review C++, but that hasn't happened. @Aleksandr Medvedev would you be willing to take ownership of the C++ backend of wit-bindgen? I'm happy to rubber stamp PRs and such but I 'd like to have someone on file who can respond to issues, review PRs, etc. I think there's a nontrivial backlog of C++ PRs other than your two which ideally all need to be addressed at some point as well
Hey, yeah sure! I can do pretty much both C and C++, and potentially others in the future. Just keep in mind that I have my own projects (using WebAssembly) that take up most of my time
Would you be up for setting aside some time to review the preexisting C++ PRs?
Yeah sure, but what will happen with mine PRs?

I can try to give them a once over, but if you're willing to help take up ownership of the C++ generator, then I think it would be good to start off by not only prioritizing your own change but also helping out others'
